title: sec.alert.v1
description: Phase 7 §7.4: defense-agent observability envelope. `kind` is an open enum (per §7.4 doctrine: producers emit only known kinds — see `KNOWN_SEC_ALERT_KINDS` in payloads.py — consumers tolerate unknown kinds and route by `severity`). `evidence_ref` is a content-addressed pointer (sha256) into `sec.quarantine.v1`; alerts NEVER inline the offending bytes (cardinality + log-injection guard). Mirrors `ai/swarm/agents/payloads.py::SecAlert`.

kind.description: Open enum (ROADMAP §7.4). The hand-rolled validator in `ai/swarm/sdk/schemas/__init__.py` checks pattern only; the producer-side AST scan in `test_open_enum_producers_emit_only_known_kinds` enforces that emission sites use only `KNOWN_SEC_ALERT_KINDS`.

reason.description: Free-form human-readable diagnostic. Capped at 1024 chars by producers (mirrors `proof.flag.detail`); evidence pointer goes in `evidence_ref`, never inlined here.

subject.description: IP/CIDR, client_id, source_id, or other opaque subject. Payload-only — never a metric label dimension (cardinality bound).

event_correlation_id.description: Join key for maint/sec dual emits (sha256(kind|target|produced_at)[:16]); null for sec-only events.
